status: local vertical-slice implementation; not the full previous 17-route contract
httpBase: http://10.0.2.2:8000 for Android Emulator; http://127.0.0.1:8000 on PC

body.allowManualUnknown: optional boolean; explicit manual fallback acknowledgment only when current occupancy UNKNOWN

http.note: map browsing centre only, not location proof
optional quality metadata receipt, not required before claim

actions.round.pause: approved member; safe pause ignores stale epoch
actions.support.pulse: CAR_HOST; battle gate required; supplies >=1 required and consumed; 5 seconds damage 3; 0 => SUPPLY_REQUIRED
actions.fire: approved passenger; current epoch, gate and sector checked
actions.mobile.collect: Approved passenger + passengerConfirmed true; independent of vehicle/battle gate and roomEpoch. Fixed DEMO_PICKUP fixtures only, no GPS verification.

angles.coordinate: vehicle relative, -180..180 inclusive; 0 front, +90 right, -90 left, +/-180 rear
angles.overlap: intentional; sectors are game design, not physical ballistics
angles.rearBoundary: Both -180 and +180 are the same rear boundary and allowed for both rear seats

seatEvidence.SENSOR: reported OCCUPIED; not independent identity proof
seatEvidence.MANUAL_UNKNOWN: manual host approved mapping; occupancy UNKNOWN or no signal
seatEvidence.EMPTY: Current or last EMPTY remains locked across UNKNOWN/missing; new OCCUPIED or explicit host allowManualUnknown approval while current UNKNOWN can release

requirements: vehicle.report no more than 6 seconds old
gate.unknown: fail closed for UX/gear; never infer charge from switch or port-open
gate.safety: vehicle must stop locally before waiting for server response
gate.reportSequence: Native client increments reportSeq per socket; server rejects non-increasing provided seq. Missing seq is legacy demo receipt-order only.

limitations: in-memory only; server restart loses sessions/rooms/stats
HTTP/WS debug only on loopback by default
CAR_HOST self-enrollment is only for a closed demo, not production vehicle authentication
no GPS visit proof, charger API, global territory, persistent rewards, physics/AI synchronization, logout/refresh/deletion endpoints yet
authority covers game rules only; vehicle data is an untrusted client report
DEMO_PICKUP fixtures have no coordinates/GPS validation; production phone-local GPS, freshness, accuracy and authoritative location check remain unimplemented
wave: All three targets dead => CLEARED and new epoch; explicit host round.start resets HP
pendingProjection: Only own pending member; vehicle states redacted UNKNOWN, other members and zombies hidden, stats zero
collectionEligibility: Host-approved passenger seat role plus phone self-declaration only; not live vehicle-seat or driver identity proof. No car VHAL/location relay for moving collection.

worldPolicy.storage: in memory only, no raw phone position stored/broadcast
worldPolicy.claimResult: locationValidated indicates reported input checks only; hardwareAttested false; emulator source => MOCK_DEMO
